qa_pairs.question: What information is displayed on the CPU graph for GPU tasks?
qa_pairs.answer: The CPU graph allows users to visualize the usage of the requested CPU cores over time for GPU tasks.

qa_pairs.question: How can users customize the view of CPU cores on the CPU graph for GPU tasks?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can select or deselect different CPU cores as needed on the right side of the CPU graph.

qa_pairs.question: Under what circumstances is the CPU graph not available for GPU tasks?
qa_pairs.answer: The CPU graph is not available for very short tasks.
